characters.name: Commodore Aldric Fenn (Retired)
characters.role: Foundation contact in Liege. Hall's man. Contract broker.
characters.appearance: Late sixties to seventy. Lean. Deeply weathered face from decades of salt wind. Pale grey eyes, entirely steady. Plain coat. Moves with the quiet economy of a lifelong sailor — no wasted motion, no hesitation on a gangplank.
characters.bearing: Civilian clothes but not civilian posture. Weight slightly back. Watches everything. Catalogues and files without appearing to. Walked the length of the far pier without being heard.
characters.known_history: Served with Admiral Hall on the Aldenmere patrol 31 years ago. Both were lieutenants. Disagreed about most things except that the Alliance was lying to its people about the world. That was enough. Retired naval officer. Deeply loyal to the Foundation.
known_to_player: Hall still pitches lefty and lies about it
Has been waiting 3 months for Hall to send someone
Will not reveal Foundation secrets until trust is earned
Departs at first light — contract deadline is before dawn
characters.contract_offered: Escort cartographer Wendy Dale from a position 3 days' sail from Liege through Sinochia fog waters to Foundation archive in Ombreval. Route: north through Dagnarius waters, then west into fog margin. Fenn navigates approach, Wendy Dale navigates interior, players provide vessel and guns.
characters.notes: Warned about the masthead — knows it broadcasts and that things in the fog waters notice such things. Will not ask about it directly. Tests assets before trusting them. Tested the player by approaching unseen on the pier.

characters.name: Wendy Dale
characters.location: Unknown position, 3 days' sail from Liege. Will not wait longer than that.
characters.known_history: Spent 11 years mapping the Sinochia fog waters from the inside — not from the edge, from inside. Has charts that do not exist anywhere else: what is in the fog, what lives there, what is built there. Has been moving carefully for 2 years to avoid Acme.
known_to_player: Is a cartographer, not a courier
Has unique fog water charts Acme wants destroyed
Has been evading Acme for 2 years
Is waiting at a position Fenn will only reveal once underway
Will not wait longer than 3 days from now
characters.notes: The real cargo. The charts are the mission. Acme wants both destroyed.

characters.name: Callo Vesh
characters.role: Mid-level enforcer and harbor spy. Stationed in Liege 6 weeks.
characters.location: Liege harbor district. Posing as a Dagnarius factor.
characters.appearance: Heavyset. Well-dressed. Always has a ledger in hand. Looks exactly like a Dagnarius factor.
characters.bearing: Professional. Careful. Not a fighter — a coordinator. Will flee rather than fight if cornered.
characters.known_history: Stationed in Liege to watch for unusual arrivals from the outer reefs. Already sent a carrier pigeon to Zephyr: 'The mask is in Liege harbor. Two primary operators. Unknown affiliation.' Awaiting Zephyr's response (48hr clock).

stat_block.special: If cornered, attempts to flee and warn Acme rather than fight. Can be bribed or turned — ambitious, not a true believer.

characters.notes: Acme's eyes in Liege. Once Zephyr's confirmation arrives, shifts from surveillance to acquisition. Can be identified, turned, or used to feed Acme false route information.

characters.name: Mira Solt
characters.role: Former Liege harbor pilot. Acme's dock infiltrator.
characters.first_seen: part2 DM doc / part2-1a (observed on middle pier)
characters.location: Middle pier, Liege docks. Checking lines on vessels.
characters.appearance: A woman moving along the far side of the middle pier, checking lines. Moves like someone who knows every dock in this harbor.
characters.bearing: Did not look at the player. This is notable — everyone else did. Professional discipline.
characters.known_history: Former Liege harbor pilot. Knows every dock, alley, and blind spot in the harbor district. Acme's job for her: get aboard the players' sloop while they are ashore and plant an arcane resonance tracking chip in the hold.
characters.notes: Cannot detach the mask — no one can. Will plant tracking chip if she gets aboard undetected. Players won't know it's there unless they search carefully. Bramble's passive +10% navigation bonus applies to noticing things wrong on a dock.

characters.name: The Brothers Kael
characters.first_seen: part2 DM doc / part2-1a (observed on bollard, middle pier)
characters.location: Bollard near middle pier entrance, Liege docks.
characters.appearance: Two large men sitting on a bollard, eating from paper wrappings. Watching dock traffic with the casual attention of men who have nowhere else to be.
characters.bearing: One made eye contact with the player and looked away first, but not quickly. Aware. Watching.
characters.known_history: Work as legitimate cargo handlers by day. Acme job: separate one player from the group and offer a 'business proposition' — meaning a knife and a quiet room.
characters.notes: Not subtle. The player clocked them on the walk through. They know they were clocked. This changes their approach — they will wait for a better opportunity rather than move immediately.

characters.name: Harwick Dray
characters.first_seen: part2 DM doc / part2-1a (observed on middle pier with clipboard)
characters.location: Middle pier, working toward far pier. Will arrive at players' vessel within 24 hours of docking.
characters.appearance: Precise, formal, never raises his voice. Seen moving between vessels with a clipboard.
characters.bearing: Does his job. That is it. Not corrupt, not cruel, just thorough.
characters.known_history: Will board the players' sloop within a day of arrival. Will find the unrecognized country crests on uniforms from the vacant island outpost (Chapter 1). Will file a report and flag the vessel for secondary inspection in 48 hours.
characters.notes: Can become an ally if handled honestly with correct paperwork. Can become a serious obstacle if they lie badly. Fenn can suppress the customs flag if the players have taken his contract.

characters.name: Sable Mourne
characters.role: Harbor archivist. Dream-influenced by R. Asilom. Will find the players.
characters.location: Liege. Will approach the players — she doesn't know why yet.
characters.appearance: Mid-thirties. Ink-stained fingers. Carries too many rolled charts. Looks perpetually sleep-deprived.
characters.bearing: Nervous. Academic. Obsessive about pre-Alliance harbor history. Has no idea she has been dream-influenced.
characters.known_history: Has been quietly excavating old harbor records for years, convinced something important is buried under the oldest dock. Has pre-Alliance harbor charts showing the sealed stone chamber beneath the far pier. Has been having strange dreams for 48 hours: water, gates, a melody she can't place.
characters.notes: Useful recurring NPC. Has access to Liege's historical records. Can provide research support for future gate network investigations. The dreams were caused by R. Asilom's fragments in the mask responding to the buried gate.

characters.name: Unknown Dockworker (Handcart)
characters.role: Observed on harbor approach road. Ruled out as Fenn.
characters.location: Harbor approach road, turned left at Chandler's Row
characters.appearance: Heavyset. Thick arms, short neck. Moving a handcart loaded with coiled rope. Boots better than a dockworker's wages should allow.
characters.bearing: Not looking at the player. Focused on the cart.
characters.known_to_player: Noticed. Ruled out as Fenn — too young, too physical.
characters.notes: Good boots noted. May be worth a second look. May be nothing.

characters.name: Unknown Man (Broadsheet, Anchor & Compass)
characters.role: Observed outside the Anchor & Compass. Possible watcher.
characters.location: Low wall outside the Anchor & Compass tavern
characters.appearance: Older man. Coat that was expensive once, maintained carefully since. Clean boots despite wet cobblestones. Broadsheet open, apparently absorbed.
characters.bearing: Did not look up as player passed. Turned a page. Hands steady. Posture of a man who has spent a long time making himself look relaxed. Eyes on the player's back for exactly three steps after passing.
characters.known_to_player: Noticed. Ruled out as Fenn — didn't acknowledge. Identity unknown.
characters.notes: Was watching. Identity unresolved. Not Fenn. Could be Foundation, Acme, Liege intelligence, or nothing. Worth noting.

characters.name: The Pastry Vendor (Name Unknown)
characters.role: Street vendor. Tactically positioned near dock entrance.
characters.location: Pastry stand, harbor approach road near dock entrance arch
characters.appearance: Approximately 45. Weathered face from long outdoor work. Hair pulled back practically. Efficient hands. Savory cases on the left, sweet on the right.
characters.bearing: Watches the street with the attention of someone whose livelihood depends on foot traffic. Remembers faces. Noted the player twice — once when they declined, once when they returned.
characters.known_to_player: Bought a savory pastry from her on the return from Hound's Dream. Salt pork and onion. Hot. Good.
characters.notes: Her position has a clear sightline to the dock entrance. She sees everyone who goes in and out. She is not a threat. She is, however, a potential information source if approached correctly. She and the player shared approximately 90 seconds of companionable silence watching the dock traffic together.
